note: Private campground on 40 acres at the north entrance of Itasca State Park; perimeter sites are the more private ones, the central circle the more social. Within biking and walking distance of the park; canoe access to the Mississippi nearby. --Claude
summary: Operator site (browser; plain HTTP 406): electric $30 / W+E $35 / full $40 (tax incl., 4 people, +$2 each extra), Pines 30/50A $35, primitive $22; phone reservations; bath house, dump. Passes the price gate ($30). Google 4.8 (89). Not waterfront confirmed; pin OK.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted rate $30 a night (electric site, tax included; no year on the page, same table read 2026-10-16 and 2026-11-11) - passes the US$50 gate. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Voyageurs NP 210 km) - not needed. Presence: operator website with phone 218-266-3990 (www.campitasca.com answers 406 Mod_Security to plain HTTP but loads in a browser). Google Maps 'Camp Itasca' 4.8 stars from 89 reviews, phone +1 218-266-3990, website campitasca.com. No Good Sam Park status (stored good_sam false).

Long-stay: the operator leads with nightly rates and posts them; 'Seasonal Rates Available' / 'Seasonal - Call for availability and price' is a side offer. Imagery shows a tight row of about 25 trailers along the NE spur road that look like seasonal units, plus scattered sites in the circle; the share of nightly sites is not published. Reads as an ordinary nightly campground with a seasonal row, not mostly seasonal.
Primitive sites ($22) not used as the base: the page does not say a motorhome may use them; base kept at the $30 electric site.

Rates page says full hookups are '30 Amp service' while the home page says 'Full Hookups with 30/50 Amp Service' and the new Pines sites are 30/50; electric 50 kept on the home page and Pines wording.

Pin 47.25463,-95.21217 sits at the campground entrance on CR 2; the sites lie 100-250 m east and northeast on imagery (Google's point 47.25502,-95.20992 is ~175 m E). OK as stored. Not waterfront confirmed (no water at the campground).
